enumDescriptions: Experimental built-in tracer with a limited feature set
djangoProcessDebugger.engine.description: Debug engine used for new attach sessions. Restart an already-activated target process before switching engines.

djangoProcessDebugger.justMyCode.description: When true, the debugger only steps through your code. When false, it also steps into library/framework code (e.g., Django, Celery internals).

djangoProcessDebugger.redirectOutput.description: Redirect stdout/stderr to the VS Code Debug Console. When true, print() output appears in the Debug Console instead of only in the terminal.

djangoProcessDebugger.hotReload.description: When true, changed Python files are hot-reloaded via importlib.reload() without restarting the Django process, keeping the debug session alive. Django's autoreloader is suppressed while active.

djangoProcessDebugger.mcp.enabled.description: Start a private, workspace-scoped MCP endpoint in each trusted VS Code window for Claude, Codex, and other MCP clients.

djangoProcessDebugger.mcp.allowControl.description: Allow connected MCP clients to attach, manage MCP-owned breakpoints, and pause, continue, step, or disconnect Django debug sessions. Runtime inspection remains available when disabled.

djangoProcessDebugger.mcp.allowEvaluate.description: Allow MCP conditional/log breakpoints and django_expression_inspect. Disabled by default because debugger expression and Python property access can execute application code.
